rationale: Provisional status recommendation: NO by the 2026-10-14 cutoff. The official original EO 13980 (86 FR 6817-6820) and complete page images were inspected. EO 14029 §1 expressly revokes EO 13980 in its official May 19, 2021 Federal Register text; it states no delayed effective date, and the order is signed May 14, 2021. Its §2 separately directs agencies to consider rescinding implementing policies and abolishing entities, which is not a savings clause or continuation of EO 13980 itself. The formal revocation supports status NO; first cessation of one-shot and deadline-bearing duties is unresolved because actual performance is not proved. This is a producer recommendation only.
